Menu.use: list of actions triggered from a control

rules.items: Give every item a stable value and label; kind "checkbox" or "radio" makes it a toggled option, and nested children turn it into a submenu.
rules.label: label names the menu for assistive tech; it is not shown as visible text.
rules.trigger: Pass trigger for the default button opener, or contextTarget to open the same menu from a right-click surface instead.
rules.radio: Group radio items with a shared group so selecting one clears its siblings.
